risks.risk: Gears may skip or fail to shift due to cable stretch or derailleur damage.
risks.proof: Video of the bike being cycled through all gear combinations while the rear wheel is spinning.
risks.if_unproven: as needing derailleur alignment and new cables.

risks.risk: Brake pads may be worn out or calipers seized.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the brake calipers and a video showing the wheels stopping abruptly.
risks.if_unproven: as needing new pads and caliper service.

risks.risk: Suspension components may be seized or have lost damping.
risks.proof: Video of a rider compressing the front and rear suspension to show smooth travel and rebound.

risks.risk: Drivetrain wear (chain and cassette) may require replacement.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear cassette teeth and a chain wear gauge measurement.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a new chain and rear freewheel/cassette due to visible rust.

proof_requests: Video of the gears shifting through the full range.
Video of the suspension compressing and rebounding.
Close-up photo of the rear wheel hub to confirm the second disc brake.
Close-up photo of the chain and rear gears to assess rust and tooth wear.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Shockwave Dirt 4. While the seller's 'no rust' claim is contradicted by the photo, the bike can be priced as a used budget mountain bike in need of a full mechanical service and drivetrain cleaning.
